scope: Nineteenth additive identity-evidence shard. Peer-reviewed South American genotype matches are recorded at R3 only: inspectable canonical candidates, never identity-confirmed promotion.

torres2022-cereza-2390-2026-09-07.title: Identification and recovery of local Vitis vinifera L. cultivars collected in ancient vineyards in different locations of Argentina
torres2022-cereza-2390-2026-09-07.notes: Torres et al. report an exact genotype match for Cereza to VIVC 2390. Argentina's INV independently documents Cereza as a major criolla cultivar. This is scientific identity evidence, not yet a registry assertion for the Adelaide row, so it remains R3.

torres2022-criolla-grande-3241-2026-09-0.title: Identification and recovery of local Vitis vinifera L. cultivars collected in ancient vineyards in different locations of Argentina
torres2022-criolla-grande-3241-2026-09-0.notes: Torres et al. match Rosadita Criolla to Criolla Grande Sanjuanina, VIVC 3241; earlier Argentine genotype work also treats Criolla Grande as a distinct local cultivar. The Adelaide umbrella wording remains R3 pending proposition-level registry reconciliation.

aliquo2017-torrontes-riojano-15162-2026-.title: Identity and parentage of some South American grapevine cultivars present in Argentina
aliquo2017-torrontes-riojano-15162-2026-.notes: Aliquó et al. identify Torrontés Riojano as VIVC 15162. Argentina's INV and UC Davis FPS independently distinguish Torrontés Riojano from the other Torrontés cultivars. Kept at R3 until registry-grade source assertion is encoded.

aliquo2017-pedro-gimenez-24977-2026-09-0.title: Identity and parentage of some South American grapevine cultivars present in Argentina
aliquo2017-pedro-gimenez-24977-2026-09-0.notes: Aliquó et al. identify Pedro Giménez as VIVC 24977. Argentina's INV separately documents the cultivar and the SSR evidence distinguishing it from Spanish Pedro Ximénez. Kept at R3 until registry-grade source assertion is encoded.
